description: This file defines a PHP trait named PermissionTrait within the OrangeHRM leave plugin. The trait provides a method to set permissions for an employee based on user roles, intended to be used within controllers that extend AbstractVueController. It enforces that it should only be used within classes that are instances of AbstractVueController and interacts with helper classes and traits for user role management and Vue.js integration.

methods.name: setPermissionsForEmployee
methods.description: Sets permission data for an employee based on provided data groups and optional employee number; verifies the use of the trait within an AbstractVueController instance.
